children.name: Mourellina decussata
children.description: Colony erect, lightly calcified, hydroid-like, composed of cylindrical stems with a strict growth pattern. Internodes straight, 2.7 – 3.2 mm long by 0.18 mm wide, jointed at their bases, consisting of four series of zooids, arranged in 3 – 7 (mean 5) alternate pairs. Zooids divided in two parts, proximal and distal. Proximal part adnate, tubular, very long, immersed in internode and joined to proximal zooid in same plane. Distal part projecting outwards at an acute angle from the axis; spoon-shaped, with extensive area of membranous frontal wall, facing proximally. Operculum terminal, with crescentic marginal sclerite. Cryptocyst small, transversely crescentic, its distal rim forming an upwardly curved lip; continuous with tubular section, projecting horizontally into body cavity of distal section. Spines absent. Communication via uniporous septula, one between zooids in the same series, and four lateral septula — a pair near the proximal extremity joining the medial-distal part of the preceding lateral zooids, and a pair in the medial-distal part, joining the proximal extremity of the lateral succeeding zooids. Polypide with few tentacles; retracted polypides not folded, lying almost entirely in proximal section, sometimes with tips of tentacles just extending into base of distal section. Mural spinules (and perhaps spicules) projecting into body cavity throughout zooid.

children.name: Mourellina gonzaloi Reverter-Gil, Souto & Fernández-Pulpeiro, 2011
children.description: Colony repent, comprising branching uniserial series of autozooids. These divided in two parts, a proximal adnate section, long and tubular, joined to proximal zooid, and a distal projecting section, boat-shaped, broader at base, with an extensive area of membranous frontal wall, facing proximally. Operculum terminal, with crescentic marginal sclerite. Cryptocyst small, its distal half forming an upwardly curved rim; continuous with tubular section, projecting horizontally into body cavity of distal section. Outer spines and interior spinules not present. Polypide with few tentacles. New branches produced by lateral budding from one pore on one side of tubular proximal part of autozooid; pore surrounded by a rim of thickened cuticle, produced into a long, tubular portion, its distal part bent at right angles to proximal portion; distal dilatation with membranous frontal wall and cryptocyst; first daughter zooid produced by lateral budding from the right-angle bend, straight, orientated in opposite direction from first zooid. Avicularia, ovicells and ancestrula not seen.
